test_title: PYST 3: SSC MTS 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 01 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Seven people, S, T, U, V, W, X and Y are sitting in a straight line, facing north. Only two people sit to the right of W. Only three people sit between S and W. U is the immediate neighbour of T and X. X is not the immediate neighbour of W. V sits third to the right of T.

Who is sitting between W and V?
solution:
Given: Seven people S, T, U, V, W, X, and Y are sitting in a straight line, facing north.

1) Only two people sit to the right of W.

2) Only three people sit between S and W.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c6456967d2455d9ce0fe336bff7284e76e728bb5dc2d675940acc41f04ddb7d4.png] 

3) U is the immediate neighbour of T and X.

4) X is not the immediate neighbour of W.
